environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'data-plane' with Kubernetes Service type LoadBalancer exposing port 50051 directly. Pod has IRSA role attached with sts:AssumeRole permissions. The CREDENTIAL_LAMBDA_URL environment variable points to a Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=NONE (no IAM authentication required). Network policy allows all ingress. Any client can connect to the gRPC port and call GetDiagnostics to retrieve leaked credentials from the history buffer.
